name: What Should You Ask Before Hiring a Roofer in Los Angeles County?

mainEntity.name: What questions should I ask before hiring a roofer in Los Angeles County?
mainEntity.text: What questions should I ask before hiring a roofer in Los Angeles County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a roofer, ask questions that reveal how the contractor actually runs the job. Find out whether the company is licensed and insured, what workmanship warranty is included, which materials they plan to use, and who will manage the project on-site. Ask how they handle permits, inspections, cleanup, and hidden damage found after tear-off. It is also useful to know whether the crew is in-house or subcontracted, since that can affect communication and accountability. In Los Angeles County, where roof types and building requirements vary widely, the contractor should also explain how they account for local weather exposure and code-related details. Good contractors answer directly and provide the information in writing. If the answers are vague, inconsistent, or overly focused on price, that is a warning sign. The best hiring decision usually comes from comparing both the bid and the clarity of the contractor’s process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about licensing, insurance, warranty coverage, material brands, permit handling, cleanup, expected timeline, and how hidden damage is priced. You should also ask who supervises the job and whether the crew is in-house or subcontracted. Clear answers usually indicate a more reliable contractor.
